tasks.instruction: Implement normalizeLabels in src/normalize-labels.js. Trim and lowercase strings, discard blank or non-string values, preserve first-seen order, and remove duplicates. Change only that source file.
Implement retryDelays in src/retry-delays.js. Return count non-negative integer delays starting at baseMs, doubling each time, capped at capMs; reject invalid inputs. Change only that source file.
